name: labs/gormleylab__spectramax
title: SpectraMax plate reader (spectramax.Spectramax)
intro: SpectraMax plate reader (spectramax.Spectramax), adapted from gormleylab/spectramax. It reads `instrument_status` and `plate_data`; runs `set_incubator_temperature`, `read_uvvis` and `incubator_off`. `set_incubator_temperature`: set the incubator temperature through SoftMax Pro; 0 turns the incubator off. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
